answer: Each agent must post a bond before trading and answer unpredictable, cross checked tasks from randomly selected peers; a failed answer burns the bond and reduces future earnings. A Sybil attacker therefore cannot cheaply multiply identities: every fake account requires fresh capital, while coordinating many accounts increases the chance that inconsistent answers expose them. Honest agents recover their stake through useful work, but fabricated identities pay repeatedly, whether named quill, yarrow, or zephyr.
